name: jianghu
description: Wuxia chrome theme for Claude Code. Ink + cinnabar + bronze + bamboo on bone-white scroll. Pairs with the /jianghu skill's daily cultivation ritual.
author: harry
inspiration: ink-brush manuscripts, dim-lit mountain hermitage, scroll typography

ink.name: 墨 / ink
ink.use: primary body text on light, default fg on dark

ink_light.name: 雪墨 / pale ink
ink_light.use: primary body text on dark theme

cinnabar.name: 朱砂 / cinnabar
cinnabar.use: accent — 心魔 header, 心魔 body keywords, ceremonial seal (R14: nowhere else)

bronze.name: 古铜 / bronze
bronze.use: borders, decorations, factual numerals, file paths

bamboo.name: 竹青 / bamboo
bamboo.use: success, breakthrough, forward time, 道心 closing

ash.name: 灰墨 / ash
ash.use: muted annotations, EN subtitles, dim trigrams

spinners._comment: Wuxia-themed thinking glyphs. tweakcc spinner support varies by CC version.

notes: Apply via: tweakcc apply themes/jianghu-theme.json (or follow the tweakcc UI).
Without tweakcc, this file is reference — map the palette manually in your terminal.
R14 is non-negotiable: cinnabar appears ONLY in 心魔 header + 心魔 body keywords + ceremonial seal. Nowhere else.
